text: おおくの　トレーナーと　しょうぶして　ポケモンを　きたえて　いくことじゃ！

structure.jp: おおくの　トレーナーと　しょうぶして
ポケモンを　きたえて　いくことじゃ！
structure.en: you should keep training your Pokémon!

patterns.name: 〜ことだ
patterns.explanation: ことだ after a plain verb gives advice: 'the thing to do is...'. じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ. いくことじゃ = 'you should keep on (doing it)'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a verb's て-form says the action keeps going on from now. きたえて　いく = 'keep training (them)'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. しょうぶして = 'battle, and'.
